description: The developer’s team for an app (Personas › Tu equipo in the panel): people who sign in to developers.neblla.com with their own email (any Neblla account, not only a developer's), and use this MCP with their own account, each with a paper (`access`) that the server applies on every route of the panel and every tool here: "partner" (Socio: everything but money, the plan and deleting the app), "support" (Comunidad y soporte: the people of the app — users, inbox, community, groups, moderation —, the Business tab, and the sales, read only), "viewer" (Solo mirar: everything, read only), "screens" (Solo una pantalla, the default: only the custom screens given in `panels`) or "staff" (Profesional: in the Business tab, only what is theirs — the sessions they give and who is in them, their hours, their line of the accounts; they are the professional of neblla_business kind "staff" with the same email). A call the paper does not allow answers not_allowed. action "add" { email, access?, panels?: [names] | "*", role?, expiresInDays? } invites them: an email goes out and they accept it signed in with that address, within expiresInDays (1-30, 7 by default); on someone already there it changes access, panels or role (a pending invitation is sent again with a new date). "resend" { email, expiresInDays? } sends a pending or expired invitation again. "remove" { email } takes them (or their invitation) out at once; not one they sent to «Baneadas» (status banned): only they take it back, and until then "add" answers invitation_banned. "list" → { team: [{ email, access, panels, role, status: active | invited | expired | banned, expiresAt?, invitedBy? }] }. role: one of the app's roles (neblla_update_app({ roles })) — the member then also sees every panel over what the role can read, and presses its buttons where it can write. Only the owner changes the team. Who opens the draft (pre) is neblla_pre_access.

access.description: The paper: partner, support, viewer, screens (the default for someone new) or staff

expiresInDays.description: Days the invitation can be accepted in (7 by default)

name: neblla_team
